(a) Minimum stages at total reflux (Fenske). For a binary with constant relative volatility α and light-component mole fractions x_D (distillate) and x_B (bottoms):
N_min = ln[(x_D/(1−x_D))((1−x_B)/x_B)] / ln(α)
= ln[(0.95/0.05)×(0.95/0.05)] / ln(2.5) = ln(361)/ln(2.5) = 6.426 stages
(Partial reboiler counted as a stage; total condenser not counted.)

(b) Minimum reflux ratio for a saturated liquid feed (q = 1). At R_min the pinch is at the feed composition x_F = z_F = 0.40, so use the rectifying-line condition with the equilibrium y at x = x_F:
For constant α, y_eq(x) = αx / [1 + (α−1)x]
y_eq(0.40) = 2.5×0.40 / [1 + 1.5×0.40] = 1.0 / 1.6 = 0.625
R_min = (x_D − y_eq(x_F)) / (y_eq(x_F) − x_F) = (0.95 − 0.625) / (0.625 − 0.40) = 0.325/0.225 = 1.444

FINAL (a): 6.426 stages
FINAL (b): 1.444 mol/mol
